history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration investigate cases of excess reimbursements, identify their root causes and take appropriate corrective action to ensure the validity and accuracy of expenditure of health insurance plans.
history.administration_response: The Administration has fully implemented this recommendation. The Administration has formalized and delegated the authority to the third-party administrator to approve an amount of up to $50,000 in relation to the hardship provision. The Administration has also requested the third-party administrator to run regular reports to ensure that no amounts have been paid beyond the monetary ceilings. As needed, the third-party administrator has made the necessary corrections and reported those corrections to the Administration. In the light of the above, the Administration respectfully requests that the recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has completed the rectification of this issue and submitted the supporting materials, and that the third-party administrator has completed the verification and correction of relevant matters, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
